name: RMG worker, grade G5 at Tk 12,500, full month of October with overtime and an attendance bonus
source: hand-worked from the BD pack rules
working: Period 1–31 Oct 2026 = 31 days; employed all 31 (joined 2024-01-01), so every structure line is paid in full (31 ÷ 31)
HOUSE_RENT = GROSS − BASIC − MEDICAL − CONVEYANCE − FOOD = 12500 − 6700 − 750 − 450 − 1250 = 3350
Grade G5 minimum is gross 12500 and basic 6700: met
OVERTIME = round(BASIC × 2 × OT hours ÷ 208) = round(6700 × 2 × 16 ÷ 208) = round(1030.77) = 1031 (a worker, so overtime is paid)
ATTENDANCE_BONUS = 700 (entered for the run; the pack has no formula for it)
Deductions = 0 (no absence, no leave, no provident fund, no loans)
